findings.finding: Recovery.admit returns bare stop/restore phases but Recovery has no finish method; __getattr__ forwards finish to prior Normal41, whose finish only consumes its normal40-prefixed phases and otherwise delegates further. The actual120 dispatcher explicitly calls hold.finish after publishing a COMPLETED terminal. Thus these new safety phases enter an unrelated legacy hold completion path instead of a bounded new recovery completion contract. This review did not execute that path or claim an observed runtime failure.
findings.requiredChange: Add a narrowly scoped Recovery.finish for exactly its own two admitted phases (or a unique prefix plus finish), returning without legacy hold mutation and delegating all unrelated phases. Preserve dispatcher/guards and original closure checks.
findings.title: Recovery completion falls through to legacy Hold.finish
